The class directly subclasses logging.FileHandler. handleError is the required standard-library callback invoked by emit after a write failure; renaming it would restore stderr tracebacks and lose failed_writes accounting. A real handler write failure preserves the existing file, increments once, emits no stderr, and a subsequent write succeeds.

Exact int guard rejects missing, null, bool and float versions before the supported-version comparison. validate_graph is a module-level validator, so the scanner does not auto-recognize this class-owned guard. Root and nested body readers reject invalid versions without mutating input; real create/save preserve all existing Project bytes. This is a checked current Reader, not a compatibility branch.

Supported version is compared to WorkflowGraph.SCHEMA_VERSION, the same owner declaration used by Schema and builder Writer. validate_graph is a module-level validator, so the scanner does not auto-recognize this class-owned guard. Root and nested body readers reject invalid versions without mutating input; real create/save preserve all existing Project bytes. This is a checked current Reader, not a compatibility branch.
